AnalysisFields.description: Required members are those without a default (§9.1).
AnalysisFields.title: AnalysisFields

CohortLeaf.description: Another cohort of the same document (SPEC §7.2).
CohortLeaf.title: CohortLeaf

ConceptMapping.description: An exact mapping to a concept, with at most a unit conversion or a value map (§5.7).
ConceptMapping.title: ConceptMapping

DeclaredRange.description: The range a column's values lie in, in the column's type (checked with the column).
DeclaredRange.title: DeclaredRange

Disclosure.description: ``min_cell_count`` is ``null`` (off) or at least 2; without row ids it is required (§8.4).
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

EventCoding.description: Status values for an event and for censoring; no value is both.
EventCoding.title: EventCoding

ExistsLeaf.description: An existence question (SPEC §6.5); ``where`` clauses are ANDed per row of ``table``.
ExistsLeaf.title: ExistsLeaf

IdsLeaf.description: An explicit list of unit keys; not allowed inside any ``where`` (SPEC §7.2).
IdsLeaf.title: IdsLeaf

PackLeaf.description: A pack leaf, ``<pack id>.<name>``: other members are checked by the pack's schema.
PackLeaf.title: PackLeaf

ParseSettings.description:
How a text file is read; every member is given. ``header_row`` counts from 0, after the
``skip_rows`` skipped, and a ``tsv`` file is delimited by a tab.
ParseSettings.title: ParseSettings

PermissibleValue.description: A category value; categories are strings, as their constants are (§6.4).
PermissibleValue.title: PermissibleValue

Requirement.description: What an analysis needs (§9.1). Closed until M3 adds requirement predicates in use.
Requirement.title: Requirement

TableFields.description:
``observation_window`` is reserved for timeline queries (M7): until then it is refused
as an unknown member.
TableFields.title: TableFields

ValueLeaf.description: A value predicate (SPEC §6.4): exactly one of ``values``, ``range`` or ``op`` + ``value``.
ValueLeaf.title: ValueLeaf
